findings.text: tests/test_a_landing_survives_a_moving_main.py:338 asserts that the returned measurement's population main_sha equals the base the test itself passed to _record, so both sides of the assertion move together: deleting the moved branch in reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1246-1257 (judging the merge onto the current primary) leaves this assertion and line 337 true, because the stored measurement is returned unchanged. The behaviour the test names is guarded only indirectly by test_a_delivery_that_no_longer_merges_onto_primary_is_not_landed, which catches a conflict but not a stale-base judgement over a clean merge; recording the base merge._merge_tree was called with, or the judged base, would make this test fail if the branch regressed.

manifest.md:22 records the pytest arms only: the done-when also requires ruff check and ruff format --check to add no findings on the staged paths, and neither result is recorded anywhere in the manifest or in a log. Re-running both over reckon/crew/queue_landing.py and tests/test_a_landing_survives_a_moving_main.py in the reviewed tree shows them clean (all checks passed; 2 files already formatted), so the shipped code satisfies it and the gap is in the record, not the change.
